Class IuSerializationContext

java.lang.Object
iu.client.jsonb.IuJsonbContext
iu.client.jsonb.IuSerializationContext
All Implemented Interfaces:
SerializationContext
final class IuSerializationContext extends IuJsonbContext implements SerializationContext
One serialization call: the options snapshot and property path from IuJsonbContext, plus the values in progress for re-entry and cycle checks.

The call in progress is held by IuJsonb per thread, so adapters that only see a JsonGenerator, or no generator at all, still convert as part of it.

    • enterSerializer

      boolean enterSerializer(JsonbSerializer<?> serializer, Object value, IuJsonbValueAdapter<?> owner, List<IuJsonb.AdapterReference> applied)
      Marks a serializer as in progress for a value.

      A serializer that passes the same value back to this context continues the conversion it is part of, with the next serializer in the chain that isn't already in progress for the value, and finally the built-in conversion for the type owner converts.

      Parameters:
      serializer - serializer
      value - value; may be null
      owner - adapter for the declared type of the conversion
      applied - adapters already applied in the conversion
      Returns:
      true if marked; false if the serializer is already in progress for the value
